teaching.draftCaption: Published adult renal ultrasound example. The source marks a column of Bertin (*), a medullary pyramid (**), cortex (***) and renal sinus (****). Calipers illustrate a length measurement; the displayed 13.36 cm is not a universal normal-size standard.
teaching.lateralityNote: No explicit side in the source caption. Do not interpret the measurement-box L as left or infer a side from the selected atlas kidney.
teaching.sourceRelation: Independent published subject; neither atlas donor nor user CT/MRI subject. Links are not same-side, same-patient or spatial correspondence.

privacy.visualInspection: Both retrieved renditions inspected. No legible patient name, date of birth or patient identifier observed. Small clipped marks at the top edge and scanner measurement/depth overlays remain; originals are unedited.
privacy.metadataInspection: Candidate inspected with System.Drawing: date-time 2016:03:28 11:28:30, chromaticity/gamma and JPEG properties. No patient fields observed in that inspection. This is not a guarantee of anonymity or consent.
privacy.consentEvidence: No explicit patient-specific consent or ethics statement found in the retrieved review article. Do not invent one; owner must consider whether publication evidence and de-identification are sufficient for reuse.

ownerReviewRequired: Confirm teaching suitability, source landmark labels and acceptable image quality.
Confirm orientation/plane wording; leave laterality unknown unless independently established.
Review the 13.36 cm measurement caveat and avoid normative size claims from this single figure.
Inspect full-resolution pixels, clipped edge marks and metadata; decide privacy/consent sufficiency for publication.
Record explicit per-asset approval or requested changes. No approval is inferred from the instruction to proceed.
integrationPlan: After the required owner decisions, expose a collapsed teaching-image card in existing kidney Ultrasound tabs, with preserved aspect ratio, enlargement, source/credit/licence and an independent-example label. No new persistent sidebar, invented registration, automatic lecture access or diagnostic pixel editing.
